text:
deploy-bot: Rollout started: inference-api v3.14 -> canary 10% (eu-west-1). watching rollout/status.

sarah.ng: seeing repeated crashloops on the canary pods, 502s from the ingress. tagging logs. :eyes:

sarah.ng: logs excerpt:
```
2024-11-19T21:05:12Z sidecar-init ERROR annotation parsing failed: ttl annotation must be integer seconds, got '5m'
2024-11-19T21:05:13Z main   FATAL failed to start: sidecar init error
```

mike-oncall: oncall here, thanks. pausing rollout now. executing `kubectl rollout pause deploy/inference-api`

incident-bot: Paging eng-oncall (mike-oncall) — high severity: canary crashloop + customer 502s (eu-west-1)

mike-oncall: I see HPA scaling behavior weirdly dropping desiredReplicas to 1 during node drains. running quick check: `kubectl get hpa -n inference` -> target CPU 50%, minReplicas 1, maxReplicas 20.

infra-bot: There was an automated node drain in eu-west-1 due to an autoscaler replacement. Several nodes went NotReady and kubelet started evicting pods. eviction timeout overlapped with our init container preStop which caused pods to fail fast.

mike-oncall: immediate mitigations:
- pause rollout (done)
- patch HPA minReplicas=3 to avoid being scaled down during drain
- apply temporary admission override to accept numeric TTL annotation

mike-oncall: commands I ran:
```
kubectl rollout pause deploy/inference-api -n inference
kubectl patch hpa inference-api-hpa -n inference -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'
kubectl annotate deploy/inference-api -n inference r/inference-ttl-fix=true --overwrite
```

support-led: Customer impact: our monitoring shows a ~12% spike in 502/504 errors from EU users from 21:04-21:22 UTC. A subset of streaming customers saw connection resets. I opened incident status on status.redwood.com.

jess-oncall: taking over mitigation from mike. I'm going to rollback the canary to v3.13 and run a controlled re-release after a fix. informing product + comms.

jess-oncall: rollback command:
```
kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-api -n inference --to-revision=56
```

ops-bot: rollback started by jess-oncall; previous revision 56 restored. health checks passing on 3 control pods.

sarah.ng: after rollback, logs no longer show the ttl parse error; sidecar init OK. will open PR to change annotation format validation and add unit test.

mike-oncall: confirmed HPA patched back to minReplicas=2 as a temporary baseline until we validate node-drain timing.

infra-bot: we've paused automated node replacement in eu-west-1 and are draining nodes manually with longer grace windows.

support-led: customer comms: posted update that we experienced degraded traffic for EU users, root cause under investigation, mitigation in place (rollback). No ongoing customer-facing errors reported for last 10m.

jess-oncall: handoff to postmortem owner mike-oncall. action items so far:
- revert annotation parsing to accept human durations or enforce numeric seconds at build time (sarah.ng)
- improve HPA safety net around node drains (infra + eng-sre)
- add a canary gating test for init/sidecar failures (eng-runtime)
- update runbook for pause/rollback steps (ops)

incident-bot: Incident severity: SEV2 -> mitigated. Will create incident ticket and schedule follow-up. :white_check_mark:

mike-oncall: closing thread here — I remain reachable if anything regresses. great cross-team response. :thumbsup:
